title: STAAR Surgical Releases Landmark Global Report Showing Structural Multi-Market Shift Toward Lens-Based Vision Correction
summary: LAKE FOREST, Calif., September 10, 2026--STAAR Surgical Company (NASDAQ: STAA), the global leader in phakic IOLs with the EVO™ family of Implantable Collamer® Lenses (EVO ICL™) for vision correction, today released a new report entitled The Future of Refractive Surgery, the first comprehensive global market analysis showing a consistent, multi-market migration toward implantable lens correction driven by durable tailwinds on the demand and clinical sides of the market.

title: STAAR Surgical Names Former CEO David Bailey as Chief Commercial Officer
summary: LAKE FOREST, Calif., September 09, 2026--STAAR Surgical Company ("STAAR" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: STAA), the global leader in phakic IOLs with the EVO family of Implantable Collamer® Lenses (EVO ICL™) for vision correction, today announced the appointment of David Bailey as Chief Commercial Officer. Mr. Bailey will join STAAR's executive committee and report to Warren Foust, President and Chief Executive Officer.
